query: Bazzite 44 release notes Mesa kernel version AMD recommended desktop 2026
answer: The sources indicate that Bazzite 44 ships with Mesa 26.2.1 and the latest Linux kernel 7.2. For the Mesa version, the sources mention Mesa 26.0.4 in the testing branch and Mesa 26.2.6 in the stable release. The recommended Mesa kernel version for AMD desktop users in Bazzite 44 is Mesa 26.2.6. This version includes bug fixes and compatibility enhancements for Vulkan and RadeonSI, improving stability and frame pacing in games.

results.title: Bazzite Linux 44 Lands with Kernel 7.2, New Gaming Stack, and GUI Updater
results.content:
Under the hood, Bazzite has changed its kernel strategy. The custom kernel has been retired, and every image now uses the kernel maintained by the Open Gaming Collective. The current release ships with the latest and greatest Linux kernel 7.2.

On the graphics side, Bazzite 44 ships Mesa 26.2.1 together with the kernel’s VRAM overcommit and dmem cgroup functionality. The team also backported scheduler improvements from the Linux kernel 7.3 development cycle. [...] It is worth noting that Bazzite itself is not offered as one single image. Instead, the project maintains several editions depending on the target hardware and intended usage. For conventional desktops and laptops, users can choose the standard Desktop edition with KDE Plasma or GNOME.

There are also separate images for AMD and Intel graphics, plus dedicated NVIDIA variants. For newer NVIDIA hardware, additional nvidia-open images use NVIDIA’s open kernel modules. [...] AMD users can experiment with HDMI 2.1 FRL, ALLM, and VRR support. For now, the functionality is optional and can be enabled through a ujust command or Bazzite Portal to reduce possible regressions.

Greenboot now handles failed-boot detection and automatic update rollbacks, while bpftune provides automatic kernel network tuning. The Vulkan Low Latency layer is included, along with MakeMKV and libmmbd for Blu-ray playback and several kernel modules for gaming peripherals and capture devices.
